content_md:
Network State's takeover of Farcaster is way more intellectually interesting to me than I initially expected.

Most of the timeline's energy right now is emotional, related to loss and injustice. People want to be seen and heard, whether they are on Team Gray or Team Never Gray.

But the Farcaster network has always had high numbers of Deplatforming Experiencedooors, We Are So Early What's Next Droppoooors, and Notice Me Senpaioooors. Very few Deep Thinkoooors on the level of Balaji.

Steelman: the new Network State social network is experiment 1 of N of an AI-enabled opt-in public space. The tuning knobs for experiments 2, 20, and 2000 can be turned for more/less dissent. They picked an appealing set of model calibrations for their Experiment One.

I think if you complain about techno-fascism, you might be missing the techno-optimist point of the experiment.

The question at hand is: can new AI policing tools unlock a better commons, than humans could achieve previously?
